title: Police at the door
intro: Steps to follow if the cops are at your door — local police, FBI, ICE, or any other government agent
moreInfo: More info and other guides at:

bullets.doNotOpen: Do NOT open the door unless they have a warrant signed by a judge (not an agent)
bullets.ifOpened: If you opened the door, step outside and close it behind you. Say “I do not consent to a search”

magicWords.heading: 2. Use the magic words
magicWords.intro: Say these phrases to protect your rights:

phrases.noConsent: “I do not consent to a search”
phrases.attorney: “I want to speak to an attorney”

numbered.ask: Ask, “Do you have a warrant?” Check that it’s signed by a judge (says “court” not “agency”)
numbered.doNotInterfere: If so, do not interfere with their search/arrest
numbered.phoneOff: Turn off your phone to protect your data
numbered.video: Ask a housemate to take a video if possible
numbered.callContacts: Ask a housemate to call emergency contacts

bullets.copsLie: Cops can lie to you and frequently do lie to get information they want. Do not lie to them.
bullets.solidarity: We don’t talk to the cops. Our solidarity against state repression helps protect everyone.
